mainEntity.name: Do you rebuild both the 4.2 and 5.0 XK engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We work on the Jaguar XK 4.2 V8 and 5.0 V8 engines, and every job starts with a thorough assessment of the engine.

mainEntity.name: What is the Jaguar XK engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on the engine type, unit availability and labour required. We quote after assessing your XK rather than giving a fixed price.

mainEntity.name: Can you supply a Jaguar XK reconditioned engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Where replacement is the better choice, we can supply and fit a reconditioned V8 matched to your XK's engine code.

mainEntity.name: Do you have a Jaguar XK engine for sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: We can source reconditioned XK engines depending on availability. Send us your registration and we will check suitable options for your car.

mainEntity.name: Does a start-up rattle mean the tensioner has failed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. A rattle can have several causes. An inspection is needed to confirm whether the timing chain tensioner or another component is responsible.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Jaguar XK engine rebuild take?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the fault, parts availability and machining required. We will give you an estimated timeframe once the engine has been assessed.

mainEntity.name: Can you collect my XK from anywhere in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We offer UK-wide collection and delivery from our Essex workshop, so your XK can reach us wherever you are.
